caption:
Chinese shares rise as Beijing signals more support for markets

Authorities vowed stabilization policies amid increased volatility in global markets.

Reported by The Wall Street Journal; Financial Times.

headlines: Chinese shares rise as Beijing signals more support for markets
photo_alt: A wall of stock prices in green and red
dek: The CSI 300 index posted its biggest one-day rise in two years after months of weakness.
body: State media ran a rare intraday readout in which top policymakers pledged market liquidity support. Authorities reiterated support for capital markets and vowed stabilization policies. The moves came amid increased volatility in global markets.
